description: This file defines the ResolveTableConstraints class, a rule for resolving and enforcing table constraints, particularly check constraints, within Spark's logical plan analysis phase. It processes logical plans to add invariant checks based on table constraints.

classes.name: ResolveTableConstraints
classes.description: A rule that enforces table constraints, especially check constraints, during logical plan analysis in Spark SQL.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Overrides the apply method to process a logical plan, adding check constraints where applicable.

methods.name: containsCheckInvariant
methods.description: Checks if a logical plan contains a CheckInvariant condition.

methods.name: buildCatalystExpression
methods.description: Builds a Catalyst expression from a Check constraint, parsing or converting the predicate.

methods.name: buildColumnExtractors
methods.description: Recursively extracts column references from an expression into a map for constraint checking.
